name: codefriends
description: Thin status-bar badge plus an opt-in Connect CodeFriends? prompt. Chat stays outside the IDE — this is not Cursor account login.

commands.title: CodeFriends: Sign out of this editor

codefriends.popoutUrl.description: URL of the lightweight CodeFriends popout (PWA / browser window), or codefriends://open to hand off to the desktop app. The extension does not embed chat.

codefriends.serverUrl.description: CodeFriends API used only for the status-bar online count.

codefriends.pollMs.description: How often the status bar polls /api/presence.

codefriends.provider.description: Popout ?provider= hint. auto uses Cursor when the IDE is Cursor, otherwise generic (VSCodium / vanilla VS Code / Continue-style). generic is CodeFriends identity, not Ollama SSO.

codefriends.connectPrompt.description: Show the opt-in Connect CodeFriends? prompt on activate when no session is stored and the user has not chosen Don't ask again.
